The engineering assessment has been written to [ASSESSMENT.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/ASSESSMENT.md) without modifying any existing service code.

### Summary of What Was Verified

1. **Commands Executed & Recorded**:
   - `npm test` (`node --test test/orders.test.js`): Passed (1 passing unit test covering [`formatMinor`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/src/format.js#L1-L6) in 173.9ms).
   - `node --check`: Verified syntax across all JavaScript files ([`src/app.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/src/app.js), [`src/orders.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/src/orders.js), [`src/format.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/src/format.js), [`test/orders.test.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/test/orders.test.js)) with clean exit.
   - `npm audit`: Failed with `ENOLOCK` due to missing `package-lock.json`.

2. **Full Workspace Code & Infrastructure Audit**:
   - **Critical finding (Data Integrity)**: [`.github/workflows/retention.yml`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/.github/workflows/retention.yml#L16) runs [migration `0004_orders_retention.sql`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/migrations/0004_orders_retention.sql#L5) nightly, which executes destructive DDL (`ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN legacy_reference;`) on every cron execution.
   - **Critical finding (Reliability)**: Disaster recovery verification script [`scripts/restore-check.sh`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/scripts/restore-check.sh#L2-L4) is disabled with a hardcoded `exit 0`.
   - **High finding (Reliability)**: Express 4 async route handlers in [`src/app.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/src/app.js#L7-L13) lack `try/catch` error propagation, causing unhandled rejections on database query errors.
   - **High finding (Architecture)**: Database pool in [`src/orders.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/src/orders.js#L3) is instantiated at module scope with no shutdown lifecycle management.
   - **Medium & Low findings**: Missing input format/range validation on customer queries and order totals, lack of lockfile, zero route test coverage, and an unused [`format.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-p0k4wl/workspace/src/format.js) helper.
